record.name: Apify
record.one_liner: The Apify API (version 2) provides programmatic access to the Apify platform, organized around RESTful HTTP endpoints.

auth.notes: You can find your API token on the Integrations page in the Apify Console. Use it in the request's Authorization header as Bearer <token> or as the token parameter in the URL.

access.notes: The pricing page lists a Free plan that allows users to start for free with no credit card required.

api_surface.notes: The Apify API (version 2) is organized around RESTful HTTP endpoints and offers multiple official API clients.

mcp.notes: The documentation mentions discovering and using Actors with AI agents and LLMs via the Apify MCP server.

buildability.reasoning: The platform offers a self-serve free tier with no credit card required, along with a documented REST API and official SDKs that use API token authentication.

evidence.claim: The Apify API (version 2) is organized around RESTful HTTP endpoints and uses a secret API token in the Authorization header as Bearer <token> or as a token parameter.
A Free plan is available to start for free with no credit card required.
Lists stable and experimental API clients for Node.js, Python, Java, Rust, .NET, PHP, and Go.
Mentions discovering and use Actors with AI agents and LLMs via Apify MCP server.
